originalTitle: Carnival (CCL) Stock Drops Despite Market Gains: Important Facts to Note
summary: Carnival (CCL) closed the most recent trading day at $26.69, moving 2.15% from the previous trading session.
content:
Carnival (CCL) closed at $26.69 in the latest trading session, marking a -2.15% move from the prior day. This change lagged the S&P 500's 0.21% gain on the day. At the same time, the Dow added 0.22%, and the tech-heavy Nasdaq gained 0.16%.

The cruise operator's shares have seen an increase of 4.24% over the last month, surpassing the Consumer Discretionary sector's gain of 3.95% and the S&P 500's gain of 3.25%.

The investment community will be paying close attention to the earnings performance of Carnival in its upcoming release. The company is forecasted to report an EPS of $1.36, showcasing a 4.9% downward movement from the corresponding quarter of the prior year. At the same time, our most recent consensus estimate is projecting a revenue of $8.36 billion, reflecting a 2.59% rise from the equivalent quarter last year.

Regarding the entire year, the Zacks Consensus Estimates forecast earnings of $2.23 per share and revenue of $27.63 billion, indicating changes of -0.89% and +3.79%, respectively, compared to the previous year.

Investors should also note any recent changes to analyst estimates for Carnival. Such recent modifications usually signify the changing landscape of near-term business trends. Therefore, positive revisions in estimates convey analysts' confidence in the business performance and profit potential.

Our research reveals that these estimate alterations are directly linked with the stock price performance in the near future. We developed the Zacks Rank to capitalize on this phenomenon. Our system takes these estimate changes into account and delivers a clear, actionable rating model.

The Zacks Rank system, ranging from #1 (Strong Buy) to #5 (Strong Sell), possesses a remarkable history of outdoing, externally audited, with #1 stocks returning an average annual gain of +25% since 1988. Over the last 30 days, the Zacks Consensus EPS estimate has moved 0.02% higher. At present, Carnival boasts a Zacks Rank of #3 (Hold).

Looking at valuation, Carnival is presently trading at a Forward P/E ratio of 12.22. For comparison, its industry has an average Forward P/E of 16.87, which means Carnival is trading at a discount to the group.

We can additionally observe that CCL currently boasts a PEG ratio of 1.2. This metric is used similarly to the famous P/E ratio, but the PEG ratio also takes into account the stock's expected earnings growth rate. The Leisure and Recreation Services was holding an average PEG ratio of 1.26 at yesterday's closing price.

The Leisure and Recreation Services industry is part of the Consumer Discretionary sector. Currently, this industry holds a Zacks Industry Rank of 201, positioning it in the bottom 19% of all 250+ industries.

The Zacks Industry Rank is ordered from best to worst in terms of the average Zacks Rank of the individual companies within each of these sectors. Our research shows that the top 50% rated industries outperform the bottom half by a factor of 2 to 1.

chineseTitle: 尽管市场上涨，嘉年华 (CCL) 股价仍下跌：需要注意的重要事实
chineseSummary: 嘉年华 (CCL) 最近一个交易日收于 26.69 美元，较前一交易日上涨 2.15%。
chineseContent:
嘉年华 (CCL) 在最新交易日收于 26.69 美元，较前一交易日上涨 -2.15%。这一变化落后于标准普尔 500 指数当日 0.21% 的涨幅。与此同时，道指上涨 0.22%，以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数上涨 0.16%。

该邮轮运营商的股价较上个月上涨了 4.24%，超过了非必需消费品板块 3.95% 的涨幅和标准普尔 500 指数 3.25% 的涨幅。

投资界将密切关注嘉年华即将发布的盈利表现。该公司预计每股收益为 1.36 美元，较去年同期下降 4.9%。与此同时，我们最近的共识预测收入为 83.6 亿美元，较去年同期增长 2.59%。

就全年而言，Zacks 一致预期每股收益为 2.23 美元，营收为 276.3 亿美元，与上年相比分别变化-0.89%和+3.79%。

投资者还应注意分析师对嘉年华估计的近期变化。最近的此类修改通常意味着近期业务趋势的变化。因此，预测的积极修正传达了分析师对业务业绩和利润潜力的信心。

我们的研究表明，这些估计的变化与近期的股价表现直接相关。我们开发了 Zacks Rank 来利用这一现象。我们的系统会考虑这些估计变化，并提供清晰、可操作的评级模型。

Zacks Rank 系统的范围从#1（强力买入）到#5（强力卖出），拥有卓越的超越历史，经过外部审计，自 1988 年以来#1 股票的平均年涨幅为 +25%。在过去 30 天里，Zacks 共识 EPS 估计上升了 0.02%。目前，嘉年华拥有 Zacks 排名第三（持有）。

从估值来看，嘉年华目前的远期市盈率为 12.22。相比之下，其行业的平均远期市盈率为 16.87，这意味着嘉年华的交易价格相对于该集团有折扣。

我们还可以观察到，CCL 目前的 PEG 比率为 1.2。该指标的使用方式与著名的市盈率类似，但 PEG 比率还考虑了股票的预期盈利增长率。按昨天收盘价计算，休闲娱乐服务业的平均 PEG 率为 1.26。

休闲和娱乐服务行业是非必需消费品行业的一部分。目前，该行业的 Zacks 行业排名为 201，在所有 250 多个行业中排名垫底 19%。

Zacks 行业排名是根据每个行业内各个公司的平均 Zacks 排名从最好到最差排序的。我们的研究表明，排名前 50% 的行业的表现比排名后一半的行业高出 2 比 1。
